latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of git-commit-ai.

- Generates detailed, conventional commit messages from git diffs using AI analysis
- Automatically detects message language (Chinese/English) based on code comments
- Supports Angular commit convention and multiple commit types (feat, fix, etc.)
- Extracts and summarizes specific changes, such as function names, components, and scope
- Command-line arguments for language selection (auto/zh/en)
